reasoning_content:
Interesting — the results file shows that several builds initially failed (the `results` file has a bunch of `0`s). Then `results2` shows re-runs. The addon Dockerfile in the staging context still has `<CONTAINER_REGISTRY>` in its FROM line, but the result says demospipes-bmds-api succeeded in the `bmds-results` run… wait, in the `results` file it says `0 demospipes-bmds-api` (failure), but in `bmds-results` it says `0 demospipes-bmds-api`… no wait, it says "0 demospipes-bmds-api\n0 demospipes-bmds-executors\n0 tex2pdf-service". Hmm, 0 = failure? But the image exists.

Wait, let me look more carefully:
- `results`: mixed — some `1`s (success?), some `0`s (failure?)
- `results2`: mostly `0`s, with `1 tex2pdf-service`, `1 demospipes-bmds-api`, `1 demospipes-bmds-executors`, `1 ki-validierung`
- `mfe-results`: `0 mfe-ewm`, `0 mfe-fp`, `1 mfe-ws`, `1 shell`
- `bmds-results`: `0 demospipes-bmds-api`, `0 demospipes-bmds-executors`, `0 tex2pdf-service`

Hmm, this is confusing. Which value means success? The summary says "32 SPARK service images were built (all exit 0)". But the results file is contradictory. Perhaps the convention is inverted: 1 = failure? Let me check the orchestration script and the actual image timestamps to see whether the images are real and up-to-date.

Wait — actually, looking at the tail of the frontend log: `frontend.log` ends in ERROR (mfe-ewm/dist-injector not found), but `frontend2.log` exists (74KB, 11:34). The frontend image exists. And mfew-fixed.log ends with an mfe-ws build failure, mfe-shell.log ends with a shell build failure. These are consistent with the summary: standalone mfe-ws and shell fail (pre-existing repo source issues), but mfe-ewm and mfe-fp built fine, and the main frontend image built fine.

The `0`s in results2 — perhaps the orchestrator records exit codes differently, or those `0`s represent something else. Actually, the format of the `results` file is probably `<status> <name>`, and status is the number of successful builds out of N? No…

Anyway, let me check the orchestration script to understand the format of the results file, and check the image creation timestamps to confirm that the images were actually created (not stale).

Also, the addon Dockerfile in the staging context still has a FROM of `<CONTAINER_REGISTRY>/demospipes-base-executors:v1.24.195-main-8a31fa9`… but the build succeeded? How? If the FROM line references a non-existent registry, docker build should fail… unless the build used a `--build-arg`, or the build replaced it at runtime via sed, or the bmds_fix.sh script did something. Let me check bmds_fix.sh and bmds.log.

Actually wait — the image `demospipes-bmds-api:latest` exists with an ID. Let me check when it was created. And let me look at bmds_fix.sh to see how it was built.

Let me dig in.
